topics.title: Service Orders
topics.subtitle: Enflite fields on Infor's Service Orders form.
topics.summary: Service orders (SROs): the Enflite milestone dates, Zero Time, OEM or AS and LORC fields on the General tab.

blocks.text: **Service Orders** is Infor's form for service repair orders (SROs). Enflite added milestone dates, **Zero Time**, **OEM or AS** and the **LORC** fields to the **General** tab, and shows **Close Date** as **Commit Date** and **End Date** as **Receipt Date**. These pages cover the Enflite fields.
For every other field on the form, see [Infor's Service Orders help](https://docs.infor.com/csi/latest/en-us/csbiolh/default.html?helpcontent=mergedProjects/fsp/forms/fstopics/service_orders.htm).

In this order, under the existing Projected, Open and Start Date: **Commit Date**, **Receipt Date**, **Eval Date**, **Quote Sent Date**, **Quote Approved Date**, **Last Parts Due**, **Parts Received**, **Ship Date**, then **Zero Time** and **OEM or AS**. The **LORC** box below holds **LORC1**, **LORC2** and **LORC Notes**. Every new field except LORC Notes is also a column in the grid view.
For the service team to confirm

items: The meaning of each date is written from its label in the team's spreadsheet (SRO_form_changes_2.xlsx). Correct anything that reads wrong.
What LORC stands for and what each LORC code means.
